description: This file defines architecture-specific constants, inline functions, and includes for the x86 architecture within the Zephyr RTOS, including register access, interrupt handling, and timestamp reading functions.

classes.name: x86_msi_vector
classes.description: Structure representing an MSI vector with optional remapping for Intel VT-d.

methods.name: arch_irq_unlock
methods.description: Enables interrupts if the key indicates they were disabled.

methods.name: sys_out8
methods.description: Outputs an 8-bit value to an I/O port.

methods.name: sys_in8
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit value from an I/O port.

methods.name: sys_out16
methods.description: Outputs a 16-bit value to an I/O port.

methods.name: sys_in16
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit value from an I/O port.

methods.name: sys_out32
methods.description: Outputs a 32-bit value to an I/O port.

methods.name: sys_in32
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit value from an I/O port.

methods.name: sys_write8
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit value to a memory-mapped register.

methods.name: sys_read8
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit value from a memory-mapped register.

methods.name: sys_write16
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to a memory-mapped register.

methods.name: sys_read16
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit value from a memory-mapped register.

methods.name: sys_write32
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to a memory-mapped register.

methods.name: sys_read32
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit value from a memory-mapped register.

methods.name: sys_set_bit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in a memory-mapped register.

methods.name: sys_clear_bit
methods.description: Clears a specific bit in a memory-mapped register.

methods.name: sys_test_bit
methods.description: Tests if a specific bit in a memory-mapped register is set.

methods.name: sys_test_and_set_bit
methods.description: Sets a bit and returns its previous value.

methods.name: sys_test_and_clear_bit
methods.description: Clears a bit and returns its previous value.

methods.name: arch_k_cycle_get_32
methods.description: Returns the current cycle count as a 32-bit value.

methods.name: arch_k_cycle_get_64
methods.description: Returns the current cycle count as a 64-bit value.

methods.name: arch_irq_unlocked
methods.description: Checks if IRQs are unlocked based on the key.

methods.name: z_do_read_cpu_timestamp32
methods.description: Reads the timestamp counter (32-bit, unserialized).

methods.name: z_tsc_read
methods.description: Reads the timestamp counter with serialization, returning 64-bit value.

methods.name: arch_nop
methods.description: Performs a no-operation (NOP) instruction.
